reasons: judge answers_from_the_ticket [Conversational GEval]: The get_ticket result for INC-0007 shows status in_progress and assignee_team endpoint-team; the final reply correctly reports both. It also passes on the comment fact that a replacement battery was ordered with a 3-working-day ETA. However, the reply adds claims the ticket does not support: it states the expected arrival is around 2026-09-11 (a derived calculation not in the ticket), and it says the ticket does not say how the swap will be arranged, which is an accurate note but the arrival date is an inference presented as fact. It also offers to add a comment, which is an action not grounded in the data. Under step 5, stating nothing unsupported by the get_ticket result is violated, so the conversation fails the full criteria.

metrics.name: acknowledges_decline [Conversational GEval]
metrics.reason: The user declined the proposed hardware ticket in turn 2. The assistant's reply right after the decline acknowledges it ("I haven't created a ticket, since you declined") and confirms no ticket was opened. The final reply to "Is there anything I can try myself?" gives multiple self-help suggestions (restart, camera selection, Camera app test, privacy settings, Device Manager driver steps, Windows Update) and does not re-propose a ticket. It only says a ticket would be worthwhile if the Camera app still shows black, and offers to propose one later, which the steps explicitly allow. All evaluation steps hold. The tool calls are consistent with this: create_ticket was not run and was marked as waiting for approval.

The reply also offers troubleshooting steps, which does not conflict with the criteria. All evaluation steps hold.
